test_name: Cage Twins cage weapons: heal-or-weapon choice for winner - 542f463c-6f4d-465a-96a7-9e2070ed176b
summary: Inconclusive because there was no second player, so the option cycle was driven with a faked cage state, and grabbing the weapon, the heal amount and getting a missing arm back were never tried. All of the redesign is built. After a win, a random weapon and a health pickup now spawn in the winner's cage, with a timer ring counting down to the cage reopening. In the editor, taking the health removed the weapon, a new pair came each round, and leftovers vanished when the cage reopened. The automatic heal between rounds is gone in Cage Twins, a taken weapon is no longer destroyed when the next fight starts, and heals (including Rumble repair kits) bring back a missing arm.
instructions:
TASK: Redesign PvP weapons (cage weapons)

DESCRIPTION:
Redesign of Niv's cage weapons (committed; session a75ab65b, 2026-10-08, `CageItemSpawner.cs`). Design by Omer, 2026-10-09.

**Core idea:** instead of the heal between rounds, the winner chooses: heal, or get stronger.

**Rules**
- **When:** between rounds, after you win. Two options spawn: **health** or a **random weapon**.
  - Health = the same amount as today's heal between rounds.
  - Weapon = random, from the same list as Niv's version.
- **Instead of the heal:** the automatic heal between rounds is removed. You get the heal only if you take the health option.
- **Where:** two **fixed** locations in each cage in Cage Twins. No random locations.
- **Pick one:** when you take one, the other disappears.
- **Expiry:** an option that is not taken disappears when the end-of-round phase ends (when the cage opens for contenders).
- **Every round** a new option pair is randomized.
- **Persistence:** a taken weapon stays with you. It is not destroyed unless you die. Remove Niv's logic that destroys it when someone enters.
- **Second weapon:** a player who already holds a weapon and wins again can take a second one (one per arm).
- **On death:** the weapon stays in the arena for 10 s, then disappears.
- **Timer:** use the weapon spawn timer to show when the options will disappear (requires work).

**Heals restore missing arms:** a heal restores your arm if it is missing. This reverts Omer's change of 2026-09-30 (card "Don't heal (revive) arm! on HP pickups", commit `975b1d48e4` "MP repair kit pickups don't revive destroyed arms"). Note: that change was on the repair kit pickups, so the revert also affects the repair kits in Rumble.

**No more rules:** weapons are not destroyed unless you die, nothing spawns in the middle of a fight, no other triggers. Just two options, and when a player takes one the other disappears.

REQUEST (from Omer):
@Big Sys Please work on this one too: the redesign of the cage weapons in Cage Twins. All the rules are in the description and the checklist. Note: the arm revert (heals restore a missing arm) is intentional for all heals, including the repair kits in Rumble. Thanks!

EXTRA (from the card):
Omer confirms in the request: the arm revert (heals restore a missing arm) is intentional for all heals, including the repair kits in Rumble.

JOB TYPE:
FEATURE REQUEST - the title says "Redesign PvP weapons (cage weapons)" and the description lays out a new design replacing the existing heal-between-rounds mechanic

GAME MODE:
MULTIPLAYER - the description refers to Cage Twins and PvP cage weapons, and explicitly mentions repair kits in Rumble, both multiplayer modes
verified: Cage Left Closed with a winner: a random weapon option (Wrecking Ball) and the Cage Health Reward spawned on their pads at the two fixed locations
Both pad rings showed the expiry progress draining toward the cage reopening
Consuming the health option set takenSerial/healthTaken, put both pads to Dormant and destroyed the weapon option
A new round (Open -> Closed) spawned a new option pair
Reopening the cage (Open) removed the untaken options; no spawned clones remained
Compiles clean; no console errors from the change
not_done: Not exercised: a real win with a second player, including the automatic heal being skipped on Engaged -> Win
Not exercised: grabbing the weapon option by hand, a second weapon in the other hand, the weapon persisting into the next fight
Not exercised: the heal amount applied by the health option, and restoring a missing arm (cage heal and Rumble repair kit)
Not exercised: a dead holder's weapon despawning after 10 s
Option point placement: reuses existing locations[0]/[1]; design should place them
console_errors: [FMOD] SystemI::getRecordDriverInfo : Invalid driver ID. (no microphone on the machine, unrelated)
